messages:
anya: hi team, I'm Anya (SE, started today) 44b quick Q: where do I ask about laptop VPN, Okta MFA, and building access? also which channels for PR asks and standup-bot tweaks?

sam: welcome Anya! Access stuff -> #help-access and tag @people-ops. For immediate blocking access, ping @infra-oncall in the thread.

oliver: PR review etiquette: put the PR link, a 1-line summary, and who you want to review in the PR itself. If you want a faster ping, post a short message in #eng with the link and mention the reviewers. No need for @channel unless it's org-wide.

anya: thanks. where to ask about making remind-bot posts for a team ritual?

devex-bot: For bot config requests, open an issue in #devex and include: bot name, channel, cron/schedule, message text, and a maintainer to own it. Example: `repo: infra/bots remind-bot`

sam: extra etiquette tips: 1) always use threads for replies to keep the channel tidy, 2) react with :eyes: or :thumbsup: to ACK instead of a follow-up message, 3) use DMs for 1:1 coordination, 4) check pinned messages before asking.

people-ops: badge & onboarding: submit the form in #help-access (link pinned). People-ops will reach out with a calendar slot for badge pickup. If you need hardware, add details to the Hardware Request doc in #eng-infra pinned.

anya: where do we post "who can review infra design?" Is that #eng, #eng-platform, or #architecture?

oliver: infra design depends on scope: cross-team system design -> #architecture, infra runtime or deploy -> #eng-platform, team-level -> #eng. Put a short PRD or doc link and call out relevant owners.

infra-oncall: reminder: only page oncall for customer-impacting production incidents. For perf questions post in #eng-sre with traces and a concise reproduction. Example header: `ENV: prod | service: model-serving | symptom: high-latency | sample trace: <link>`

anya: thanks all60a last small one: social/lunch + random chit-chat?

sam: #lunch-plans for food, #random for memes and socials. Team socials: prefer a short post in #general if it's company-wide, but calendar + Slack event for RSVPs works best.

anya: perfect, that's super helpful. i'll run `/onboard status` and ping if anything blocks my laptop setup. thanks :heart:

devex-bot: Tip: run `/onboard start anya@redwood.ai` to trigger buddy assignment and checklist. Welcome aboard!
